**ON THE p-ADIC BEILINSON CONJECTURE FOR NUMBER FIELDS**

*AMNON BESSER, PAUL BUCKINGHAM, ROB DE JEU*

44 pp, 4 sections.

**Abstract.** We formulate a conjectural p-adic analogue of Borel’s theorem re- lating regulators for higher K-groups of number ﬁelds to special values of the corresponding ζ-functions, using syntomic regulators and p-adic L-functions. We also formulate a corresponding conjecture for Artin moti ves, and state a conjecture about the precise relation between the p-adic and classical situa- tions. Parts of the conjectures are proved when the number ﬁe ld (or Artin motive) is Abelian over the rationals, and all conjectures a re veriﬁed numeri- cally in some other cases.

**Outline.** 1 Introduction; 3 A motivic version of the conjecture; 7 Examples; References
